Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the analysis of the second search result. The search results explicitly stated that Louis, Dauphin of France, was the son of King Louis XV and his wife, Queen Marie Leszczyńska. This means Louis XV is the paternal grandfather and Marie Leszczyńska is the paternal grandmother. However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Louis, Dauphin, was the husband of Maria Josepha of Saxony (who was actually his mother) and Maria Teresa Rafaela of Spain (who was his sister). By confusing the roles of parents and children, the Planner falsely identified Maria Josepha of Saxony as the paternal grandmother instead of Marie Leszczyńska.
